name: Being Hurt
overview: Scripture teaches that being hurt involves both the reality of human offenses and the divine call to forgiveness, as believers are instructed to forgive others so that God may forgive them in return (Mark 11:25). The believer’s faith in Christ assures them of eternal life and victory over spiritual adversaries (John 3:16; Mark 16:17), while recognizing that God's sovereign will is ultimately unresisted (Romans 9:19). This hope of eternal life, promised by God who cannot lie, anchors believers amid pain and suffering (Titus 1:2).
